home.title: Simple CMS
home.subtitle: Full-stack Content Management & Bookmarking System — Express 5, SQLite & Angular 22.
home.aboutBody: Simple CMS is a full-stack content management and personal bookmarking web application powered by an Express 5 + TypeScript REST API (SQLite via node:sqlite + Drizzle ORM) and an Angular 22 Material frontend. Initially generated with OpenCode, it is now enhanced and maintained using Google Antigravity (powered by Claude Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon).
home.featStackDesc: Express 5 + TypeScript backend paired with an Angular 22 + Material 3 standalone SPA.
home.featDbDesc: Uses Node's built-in node:sqlite in WAL mode with Drizzle ORM and automatic startup migrations.
home.featAuthDesc: Zero-dependency HS256 JWT & scrypt password hashing with Viewer, Editor, and Admin roles plus first-user bootstrap.
home.featBookmarksDesc: Strictly scoped per-user bookmark collection and instant English / 中文 runtime translation.
home.apiArticles: List articles, newest first — ?page=&pageSize=[&status=] for paging, plus /slug/:slug and /:id reads. Reads are public, writes need an editor role.
home.apiBookmarks: Private per-user bookmarks, login required — GET/POST plus PATCH/DELETE /:id, strictly scoped to yourself.
home.apiUsers: List and manage users, admin only — GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /:id.
home.apiLogin: Sign in with { username, password } → { token, user }.
home.apiSetup: { needsSetup }, true when the initial admin account still needs bootstrapping.
